name: Student Volunteering, Woodbridge Public Library
what_you_do: Pick a library volunteer job. You can write book reviews online for hours, or help get program materials ready at the Community Service Club. You can read with kids as a Reading Buddy, or help at the summer reading club.
who_can_apply: Library patrons in grades 7 to 12. Book reviews are for grades 8 to 12 who live in Woodbridge. Details differ by branch.
pay_detail: Unpaid. You earn volunteer hours and signatures.
duration: Most roles are all year, about 1 hour a week. Summer Reading Club volunteering is June to August, up to 5 hours a week.
deadline_text: For summer reading help, sign up in April or May. Other roles run all year.
how_to_apply: Contact the branch library. You can also write to the Teen Services team at teenservices@woodbridgelibrary.org. You can just drop in to a Community Service Club meeting.
notes: The Fords Branch Library will help you get volunteer hours for National Honor Society applications. It does this when other ways do not work.
